content.comment_body: I connected a new [product_name] Operator Device and tried to set the clock, but I keep seeing a message: "BM no response." I can adjust contrast and similar things, but no message appears. I assume BM stands for Base Module, but I'm not certain. Does anyone have suggestions?
Did you connect it to the new [product_name] controller ([article_no])? Make sure the connection between the controller and Operator Device is correct.
Hello, did you solve this issue? I'm experiencing the same problem and would appreciate any advice.

Hello everyone, The latest [product_name] Operator Device and display on the new [product_name] controller ([article_no]) aren't compatible with standard message text functions for the base module. You need to configure the software to use message texts in the new version. To update: Start [product_name] Soft Comfort [version_no] and open your project. Double-click a message text function. In the 'Parameter' tab at the bottom, there's an option to 'Enable new style message and setting.' Activate this. Once done, you can use the Operator Device and take advantage of the added features. Hope this helps. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users are encountering a confusing 'BM no response' error when connecting and configuring a new [product_name] Operator Device to a [product_name] controller module. This is due to incompatibility between hardware components and the need for updated software settings in [product_name] Soft Comfort. The main issue is limited guidance for necessary configuration steps to enable new device features.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect easy setup when connecting the Operator Device to the base module, clear instructions to resolve connection errors, and seamless compatibility between updated hardware and software.
